ana: Quick thread to settle a few dark-theme decisions before QA: stacked-area vs line semantics, SQL/code block background for copy readability, and the tooltip copy for the dashboard time-picker. felix: paste the current token snapshot? want to validate against the new chart palette. maria: also flag: syntax highlighting feels inconsistent between the editor and the logs viewer (different keyword colors). We should align semantics rather than exact hues. ana: oops meant ana :) current tokens: ``` --bg: #07080a --card: #0e0f11 --card-2: #131415 --muted-txt: #98a2a8 --primary-cool: #6fb7ff --accent-warm: #ffb69a --sql-bg: #0b0c0e --sql-fg: #dceffb --focus-ring: rgba(115,160,255,0.12) ``` felix: thanks. contrast-bot likely flags `#dceffb` on `#0b0c0e` (~4.2:1). Consider `#eaf8ff` or lift sql-bg to #0e1012. contrast-bot: automated check: `#dceffb` on `#0b0c0e` = 4.2:1 (recommend >=4.5 for inline tokens). Suggested `#eaf8ff` => 4.7:1. maria: for editor vs logs: editor uses saturated keywords to aid scanning. Logs are denser; we should desaturate keywords there and rely on bolding for emphasis. Keeps logs readable. jon: charts: stacked-area communicates part-to-whole; lines communicate trend. For mixed panels we should keep stacked-area low-opacity fills and use a distinct stroke palette for overlays. Proposal: add `--stroke-1: #5fb0ff`, `--stroke-2: #7fe3c2`, `--stroke-3: #ffad94` with 1px outer halo `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` when rendered on card-2. Fills at 0.14 alpha. nana: +1 to halo approach 0 preserves crispness at 1px and avoids thicker strokes that change perceived data. Also add pattern (diagonal hatch) for critical series (errors) to avoid hue-only signals. felix: note for small multiples: use consistent stroke widths and only vary dash/pattern for different series so users can compare small charts easily. maria: copy nit: time-picker tooltip currently says "Range" 0 users expect context. Suggest "Range (local timezone)" or "Range — local timezone". Keep it minimal for translation. jon: prefer "Range — local timezone". Minimal and clear. nana: accessibility: focus ring alpha is low on dark. Current `--focus-ring` is rgba(115,160,255,0.12). Recommend 0.18 and 4px spread. Also ensure high-contrast invert mode overrides ring color. contrast-bot: accessibility check: proposed `--focus-ring: rgba(115,160,255,0.18)` improves perceived boundary on card backgrounds. Run full `design-kit color-a11y` after token updates. felix: small example for SQL token test: ```
SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days'
``` maria: editor alignment task: I'll produce a token map showing keywords/types/strings for editor vs logs with rationale (dense vs scan). jon: charts: add legend overlay option: full-width translucent strip behind legend items (`rgba(6,8,10,0.8)`) on card-2; with subtle separators between items. Will test in storybook. nana: action items: 1) maria to deliver editor vs logs token map + rationale (due tomorrow AM). 2) felix to run `color-a11y` with updated sql-fg `#eaf8ff` and proposed focus-ring change (due today). 3) jon to prototype stacked-area + stroke-halo + pattern for errors in storybook (EOD). 4) ana to update tooltip copy to "Range — local timezone" in i18n keys and add a one-sentence note in accessibility docs explaining pattern fallback for color-blind users. maria: will include Deuteranopia/Protanopia sims in the token map. felix: ping me on the PR for a quick pass. contrast-bot: reminder: run `design-kit color-a11y --threshold 4.5 --report` and attach the report to the PR. nana: thanks all 0 I'll follow up with the i18n PR and link mocks once they're ready. :sparkles:
